meta.name: Ruben Marcus · Agent-ready dark interface system
scope: supporting site-wide recording for visual/motion language
meta.method_summary: Runtime DOM, computed styles, root CSS variables, font-face rules, responsive media rules, safe filter/menu/hover/focus/scroll interactions, two rendered viewports, and a user-supplied 30 fps screen recording were combined. Exact source copy, logos, personal imagery, and external widgets are intentionally excluded from the report.

limitations: CDP screenshot capture became unstable after the first desktop capture; DOM and computed-style inspection remained available.

principles.label: Terminal contrast
principles.value: Black canvas, cream reading text, fluorescent green signal
principles.notes: The palette is deliberately small and high-signal: green is reserved for status, active controls, markers, and links.

principles.label: Human-readable systems language
principles.value: Editorial display type is paired with code-like metadata, chips, and labels
principles.notes: The interface reads like an engineering portfolio without collapsing into a raw developer console.

principles.label: Calm surface, kinetic layer
principles.value: Static black cards and grids are animated by ticker movement, reveal, hover glow, dither, and scan treatments
principles.notes: Motion is ambient and progressive rather than a constant large-scale transition.

principles.label: Evidence before ornament
principles.value: Project metadata, counts, technologies, and links are visible before secondary decoration
principles.notes: The portfolio card anatomy prioritizes title, role/date, description, tags, and action.

typography.size: clamp(2.25rem, 5vw, 3.75rem); runtime portfolio h1: 60px desktop / 36px mobile
0.66rem–0.72rem for metadata, filters, ticker, and labels
typography.transform: uppercase for ticker and section metadata

usage: section vertical rhythm under desktop breakpoint
main and footer content above texture

iconography.value: Inline SVG, mostly filled marks for social links; thin line treatment where strokes are used
Text glyphs and bracketed markers such as ↗, +, [!] and ✦

imagery.value: Black base with green dither/voxel/scanline treatment and approximately 16:9 crop
imagery.treatment: overflow hidden, lazy-loaded image, filter/opacity/transform transition on interaction

imagery.value: Low-opacity noise plus green radial dots; some site routes add code-like or wire-floor textures
imagery.treatment: fixed pseudo-elements, pointer-events none, low opacity, blend/texture layers

rules.transformation: Inline primary nav and social links are visible; burger is hidden.
Primary nav collapses to a burger. At 390px the overlay is a full-screen dialog with 2rem display links and 40ms stagger increments.
Single-column stack; at 390px the content column is 342px with 24px side gutters.
Three equal columns; runtime sample at 1440px is 1088px wide with 20px gaps.
Fluid clamp size with text wrapping from 60px / 720px measure on desktop to 36px / 342px measure on mobile.
One column at base, two columns from 720px, then 1.2fr plus three equal link columns from 1080px.
A 32px availability ticker occupies the top edge; the header is fixed below it at top: 32px. Scrolled state adds glass background, divider, and 16px blur.

usage: hover, focus, header state, filter state

reduced_motion.value: Source CSS disables ticker/dot/card/hover decorative animation and removes card lift under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
reduced_motion.runtime_note: The inspected browser reported matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches = false; the report exposes a manual reduced-motion specimen as well.

performance_observations.label: Compositor-friendly emphasis
performance_observations.value: Most sampled motion uses opacity, transform, filter, and backdrop-filter rather than layout properties.

content_style.language: pt-BR on supplied route; English alternate available
content_style.report_handling: The living report uses neutral specimen copy to avoid copying the source site's proprietary marketing language.

exceptions.label: Featured card exception
exceptions.value: The first highlighted project card is a static article with stronger border but no linked-card lift behavior.

exceptions.label: Cards blend into the canvas
exceptions.value: Card background is the same black as the page; hierarchy comes from border, radius, image, spacing, and hover glow rather than a lighter surface fill.

exceptions.label: Glass only on scroll
exceptions.value: The header is transparent at the top and gains a translucent surface and blur after scrolling.

exceptions.label: Shared route decoration
exceptions.value: Code-like textures, wire floors, AEO/nominee widgets, and audio utilities appear in the recording or shared bundle but are not all specific to the portfolio route.

gaps.label: Mobile screenshot surface
gaps.value: The live mobile DOM and computed layout were inspected at 390x844, but the browser screenshot command timed out after the initial desktop capture.

gaps.label: Tablet runtime
gaps.value: 720px and 1080px breakpoint behavior is source-defined and high-confidence, but no separate tablet render was captured.

gaps.label: Exact route-level transition timing
gaps.value: The recording shows smooth scrolling and content pacing but does not prove exact trigger/settle durations for every route transition.

gaps.label: Form states
gaps.value: The footer email field was observed but not submitted; validation, error, success, and server response behavior remain unknown.

gaps.label: Protected source assets
gaps.value: The report intentionally omits source logos, portrait imagery, external widgets, and long source copy; the extraction describes their treatment as patterns only.

additional_findings.label: Root token visibility
additional_findings.value: The runtime exposes a compact semantic token layer on :root, including colors, type families, spacing anchors, blur, radii, motion, and z-index.

additional_findings.label: Texture is structural, not decorative only
additional_findings.value: Fixed noise and dot pseudo-elements establish depth across otherwise black surfaces, while card-specific dither/scan layers add local energy.

additional_findings.label: Counts are part of control affordance
additional_findings.value: Filter counts communicate dataset size beside each taxonomy label and the status region reports the filtered result count.

additional_findings.label: Ambient utility layer
additional_findings.value: The recording and live DOM show floating audio, nomination, and AEO-related utilities. They are contextual enhancements rather than core portfolio grammar and are not reproduced in the report.
